project_type: Full-stack e-commerce SaaS (React + Express TypeScript monorepo)
build_system: npm workspaces NOT used — backend and frontend are separate npm projects under the same repo root. Backend: tsc + ts-node-dev. Frontend: Vite. Root: docker compose.
test_framework: No automated test framework installed. Verification is TypeScript typecheck + build commands.
build_command: Backend: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit | Frontend: cd frontend && npm run build (runs tsc && vite build)
test_command: Backend typecheck: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit | Frontend typecheck: cd frontend && npm run typecheck | Frontend build: cd frontend && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit — must complete with 0 errors. 2. cd frontend && npm run typecheck — must complete with 0 errors. 3. cd frontend && npm run build — must succeed and produce dist/ files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/dist/ is produced by npm run build. backend/dist/ is produced by npm run build in backend (not checked in). Prisma generates backend/node_modules/.prisma/client from schema.prisma — run npx prisma generate after schema changes.
environment_constraints: Windows (PowerShell shell). Do NOT deploy to VM 102. Do NOT commit or push. Do NOT start Docker services (they may already be running). Work only in d:\Tugas Kuliah\UAS-CC worktree. Use forward slashes in file paths in code, backslashes in PowerShell commands.
contribution_requirements: No push/commit without explicit instruction. No destructive changes (rm -rf, force reset). Preserve existing working functionality. Mark unconfirmed info with [BELUM DIKONFIRMASI].
key_patterns: Backend: Express controllers call services, services use prisma client, all snake_case field names matching Prisma schema. Standard response shape: { success: true, data: T }. Paginated shape (after fix): { success: true, data: T[], pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }. Frontend: React Query for data fetching, Zustand for auth/cart state, Tailwind CSS for styling. All components import types from frontend/src/types/index.ts.
directory_structure: d:/Tugas Kuliah/UAS-CC/ — repo root, contains docker-compose.yml, .env.example, README.md, PROJECT_CONTEXT.md | backend/ — Express + TypeScript API, src/controllers/, src/services/, src/middleware/, src/routes/, src/lib/, src/config/, src/adapters/, prisma/schema.prisma, prisma/seed.ts | frontend/ — React + Vite + TypeScript, src/pages/storefront/, src/pages/admin/, src/components/product/, src/components/cart/, src/components/layout/, src/components/ui/, src/hooks/, src/store/, src/lib/, src/types/ | docker/ — nginx config | .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts and reports
